text:
anya: Heads-up — hitting a goroutine leak in the Go SDK generator when a stream is cancelled right after the first token. Happened in the sampleapp while testing onboarding flows.
carter: can you paste a minimal repro and go version?
anya: go1.20 on my laptop. Repro steps: start generator, read first chunk, call cancel(), wait. pprof shows ~N goroutines stuck. Minimal snippet below.

```go
ctx, cancel := context.WithCancel(context.Background())
gen, err := client.NewGenerator(ctx, &gen.Config{Model: "xsmall"})
if err != nil { log.Fatal(err) }
// read one token
tok, _ := gen.Next()
cancel() // cancel right after first token
// gen.Close() maybe not called in sample
```

lina: saw this on linux too. It looks like the internal recv/read loop doesn't select on ctx.Done() during the handshake/read window, so it keeps a goroutine alive after cancel.
carter: that aligns with what I guessed — read loop is blocking on socket read and only closed when EOF from server, not when ctx cancelled. I can try a quick branch to select on ctx.Done() and return.
morgan: this is a pretty bad DX for onboarding — the sampleapp pattern (one generator per request) will blow up if users copy it. Can we add a test and also a short note in README about proper cancellation? Also would be good to surface a metric or log when generator goroutines exceed X secs.
anya: numbers from my repro: spawn 50 concurrent streams and cancel after first token -> ~50 leftover goroutines after 30s, heap ok but goroutine count climbs.
carter: opening draft PR now with two small fixes: check ctx.Done() in handshake and in recv loop; also ensure gen.Close() is idempotent. PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/go-sdk/pull/412
devex-bot: deploy-preview created for PR #412 — CI: unit tests passed, integration flaky; re-running.
morgan: awesome, can you also add an integration-style test that cancels mid-stream so we catch regressions? Put it behind short/integration label.
carter: added a test and updated sampleapp README with a "cancellation best practice" snippet. pushed to branch.
anya: verified the branch on my mac — no leak, goroutine count returns to baseline within 2s after cancel. :tada:
morgan: great, once CI is green let's merge and backport to 0.9.x. This should reduce a lot of onboarding friction.
anya: also leaving a note for DX docs to call out the idiom: "always call gen.Close() or cancel ctx, and prefer reading until io.EOF or ctx.Done() in samples."
carter: will follow up with a small changelog entry.
anya: thanks everyone!
